uploads/science/Scipad/Year 10 Book 2/An.searchText: FORCES AND MOTION The Inclined Plane Inclined planes are ramps, and like levers they reduce the amount of effort needed to lift a load. The steeper the incline, the more effort is needed to move the load upwards. Just like levers, if you use a longer, less steep incline to reduce the effort needed, you will need to apply the effort over a longer distance. SILVERBACK ACADEMIC A.
